title: THE SCOPE ZOOM FOLLOWS A DELIBERATE AIM ONLY
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-07: on a controller every trigger pull steadies the aim for a moment, and kid firing does the same while it has a target, and since v18.76 both also pulled in the scope zoom, so with a Marksman Rifle or Longshot the view of player 2 pumped in and out by a third on every shot. The zoom now follows only a deliberate aim (LT, the stick click toggle, or the right mouse button); the steadying keeps its tighter aim without moving the camera.
now: On a controller the view no longer zooms in and out with every shot of a scoped gun; holding LT still zooms.
